cells.gaps: The 31.54% is the central bank's banking rate for the whole population and is not attributed to a survey; nothing found puts adults with an account at 53% or more.
cells.note: The central bank's 2024 report puts the population with a bank account at 31.54%, a quarter or more; not attributed to a survey, staged on it as the ladder is read now. Nothing found puts the share above half.
